articles.title: Europe’s Bomb Threats Raise Fears of Hybrid Warfare
articles.summary: Waves of bomb threats have so far proved to be hoaxes, leaving officials searching for answers about who is behind them—and why.

articles.title: The Silver Linings Of an Aging World
articles.summary: Nobel laureate Daron Acemoglu argues that our aging world needs us to invest in technology and adapt our institutions to the demands of longer lives.

articles.title: How to Keep an Open Mind
articles.summary: We’re human, so it’s not possible or even realistic to expect that every belief we hold is accurate, writes Joan M. Cook.

articles.title: How Europe's Far-Right Leaders Are Backing Away From Trump After Midterm Losses
articles.summary: While left-leaning European leaders have celebrated the Democrats’ gains in the U.S. midterms, some far-right figures in Europe appear keen to succinctly separate themselves from Trump and his policies.

articles.title: All at Once, Ted Cruz Is the Last Statewide Republican Lawmaker Standing in Texas
articles.summary: Cruz was not up for reelection this midterm cycle, but every Republican who was on the ballot in Texas’ statewide races this year has been defeated.
